# Field

> Form field wrapper for labels, descriptions, errors, and validity state.

This file matches the installed `field` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/field.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/field.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `class-variance-authority@^0.7.1`

- `core`

## Composition

### Labeled control

FieldLegend names the set: a label-size semibold title by default, or variant="section" for a list title.

```tsx
<FieldSet>
  <FieldLegend />
  <FieldGroup>
    <Field>
      <FieldLabel />
      <FieldControl>
        render prop
          <Input />
      </FieldControl>
      <FieldDescription />
      <FieldError />
    </Field>
    <FieldSeparator />
  </FieldGroup>
</FieldSet>
```

### Choice card

FieldLabel variant="card" paints the selectable tile: the whole card selects its control, the checked control colors its border and fill, and one focus ring wraps the card. FieldItem gives each label its own control inside the shared Field; FieldItem disabled disables one option. A Checkbox takes the Radio's place for multiple choice.

```tsx
<Field>
  <RadioGroup>
    <FieldItem>
      <FieldLabel>
        <Radio />
        <FieldContent>
          <FieldTitle />
          <FieldDescription />
        </FieldContent>
      </FieldLabel>
    </FieldItem>
  </RadioGroup>
</Field>
```

### Settings list

FieldLegend variant="section" titles the list. FieldGroup variant="card" pads every row and draws the dividers between rows, so rows need no classes. Field orientation="responsive" moves the control beside its text once the group is wide enough. Skins tune rows through the --cui-field-group-* knobs and label weight through --cui-field-label-font-weight.

```tsx
<FieldSet>
  <FieldLegend />
  <FieldGroup>
    <Field>
      <FieldContent>
        <FieldLabel />
        <FieldDescription />
      </FieldContent>
      control
    </Field>
  </FieldGroup>
</FieldSet>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldControl,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSeparator,
  FieldSet,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/input";
import { Switch } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/switch";

export function PrimitiveFieldExample() {
  return (
    <FieldSet className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <FieldLegend>Profile</FieldLegend>
      <FieldGroup>
        <Field>
          <FieldLabel>Display name</FieldLabel>
          <FieldControl render={<Input placeholder="Ada Lovelace" size="sm" />} />
          <FieldDescription>Shown next to your messages.</FieldDescription>
        </Field>
        <FieldSeparator />
        <Field orientation="responsive">
          <FieldContent>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor="field-product-updates">Product updates</FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription>Receive occasional release notes and product news.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldContent>
          <Switch id="field-product-updates" defaultChecked />
        </Field>
      </FieldGroup>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}
```
